primary_outcome: Arithmetic mean LFW verification accuracy over eyes, mouth_nose, upper_half and lower_half at B=1024; paired contrasts by calibration seed.
pool_hash_encoding: Array SHA-256 digests use C-contiguous bytes. Candidate IDs and remapped labels are little-endian int64 in ascending source-index order. Pixels are decoded (3071,112,112,3) uint8 RGB.
selection_archive_schema: pool_original_ids are source indices into the sorted CASIA cache. <selector>/<seed>/<budget> is a uint16 vector of positions in this pool, alternating clean and occluded. boxes/<seed> contains 512 int32 (y0,x0,side) CASIA training squares; slice the first B/2 rows.

embedding.similarity: (1 + cosine) / 2 in float64 after unit normalization

distributed.reference_pool: all candidates for all shard gains
distributed.greedy_merge: equal quotas; serpentine shard order to balance view assignments

sieve.objective: residual mean facility location after fixing the common first center

exact_facility_order_check.description: Direct all-candidate argmax and exact per-shard max reduction independently matched the recorded lazy order for each of 1,023 greedy steps after the common start. Order hashes use original source indices as little-endian int64.
